method.holdout: deterministic 20% holdout by spatial_group; all records from one group remain in one split
method.uncertainty: Deterministic 2,000-resample spatial-group bootstrap interval where at least 200 valid resamples are available; still exploratory and not an accuracy claim.

moon.interpretation: Exploratory spatial-group holdout on reviewer-labelled candidates. It is not a universal accuracy estimate; assess label quality, group design and uncertainty before drawing conclusions.

mars.interpretation: Exploratory spatial-group holdout on reviewer-labelled candidates. It is not a universal accuracy estimate; assess label quality, group design and uncertainty before drawing conclusions.

limitations: Labels must be independently sourced and reviewed; the script does not create or infer labels.
A held-out split must contain both positive and negative labels; otherwise AUC is withheld.
Spatial groups must be defined before looking at scores and should separate neighbouring or geologically related candidates.
This evaluates terrain-screening scores against supplied labels only; it does not prove planetary process equivalence or field truth.
